guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以重力排水、楔形壓榨與帶面負荷為主線，從進料乾固體、調理與藥劑活性、重力排水接觸、帶寬固體負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops gravity drainage, wedge pressing and belt loading through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry solids, conditioning and active polymer, gravity-drainage contact, solids per belt width. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「進料乾固體」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「調理與藥劑活性」的觀測點。把稀釋藥液量還原成活性聚合物，觀察絮體與濾液。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「重力排水接觸」的觀測點。對照帶速紀錄、重力段排水與泥餅含固率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「帶寬固體負荷」的觀測點。在帶面分格觀察厚度與側向漏泥。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「楔形段漸進加壓」的觀測點。量回流水量與 TSS，與泥餅 DS 相互驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「輥輪與泥餅濕重」的觀測點。稱泥餅並分析含固率，與進料 DS 閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「洗帶用水」的觀測點。以獨立沖洗支線水表與運轉紀錄交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「帶速與停留」的觀測點。對照帶速紀錄、重力段排水與泥餅含固率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「液相固體捕集」的觀測點。量回流水量與 TSS，與泥餅 DS 相互驗證。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「整體穩態交接」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed dry solids. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for conditioning and active polymer. Convert solution use to active polymer and observe floc and filtrate. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for gravity-drainage contact. Compare belt speed, gravity-zone drainage and cake solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solids per belt width. Observe thickness across belt segments and side leakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for progressive wedge loading. Measure return-liquid flow/TSS and cross-check cake dry solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rollers and cake mass. Weigh cake, analyze solids fraction and close against feed DS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for belt washing water. Cross-check a dedicated wash-water meter with operating logs. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for belt speed and residence. Compare belt speed, gravity-zone drainage and cake solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for liquid-phase capture. Measure return-liquid flow/TSS and cross-check cake dry solids. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-system steady-state handoff. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 低濃度大流量淹沒重力段。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
過量聚合物可能黏帶而非改善排水。診斷與介入：校核有效聚合物乾基，將藥耗與泥餅及濾液表現比較。
過快帶速縮短初始排水時間。診斷與介入：以實際速度和有效長度重算，配對濾液及泥餅資料。
平均負荷合格但局部堆積仍失敗。診斷與介入：重新量在線帶寬及乾固體量，排查邊緣偏料。
絮體尚未排水就進入高壓區。診斷與介入：重新量進料、濾液及泥餅固體，查回流水漏項。
表面乾內部濕造成採樣偏差。診斷與介入：同步量乾固體與泥餅重量，查固體回收率是否變化。
洗水漏列使淨產水量高估。診斷與介入：獨立量沖洗用水和回流負荷，確認噴嘴及濾帶狀態。
只改帶速卻把厚度效應誤當時間效應。診斷與介入：以實際速度和有效長度重算，配對濾液及泥餅資料。
稀釋清洗水讓濾液看似清澈卻仍高負荷。診斷與介入：重新量進料、濾液及泥餅固體，查回流水漏項。
跨污泥種類比較單一乾度造成錯誤選型。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
pitfallsEn: Large dilute flow floods the gravity zone. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
Excess polymer can blind the belt instead of improving drainage. Diagnostic response: Check active polymer on a dry-solids basis and compare consumption with cake/filtrate performance.
Excess belt speed shortens initial drainage. Diagnostic response: Recalculate with actual speed/effective length and pair with filtrate/cake data.
Acceptable mean loading can hide local overload. Diagnostic response: Remeasure active width/dry-solids load and check uneven edge feeding.
Poorly drained floc enters the high-pressure zone. Diagnostic response: Remeasure feed, filtrate and cake solids and check omitted returns.
A dry surface over wet material biases samples. Diagnostic response: Measure dry solids and wet cake together and check capture changes.
Omitted washwater overstates net water output. Diagnostic response: Meter wash water and return loads separately and inspect nozzles/belt condition.
Changing speed confounds thickness with time. Diagnostic response: Recalculate with actual speed/effective length and pair with filtrate/cake data.
Dilution makes filtrate look clearer without removing its mass. Diagnostic response: Remeasure feed, filtrate and cake solids and check omitted returns.
Comparing cake solids across different sludges misguides selection. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

courses.connection: 本課以重力排水、楔形壓榨與帶面負荷為主線，從進料乾固體、調理與藥劑活性、重力排水接觸、帶寬固體負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops gravity drainage, wedge pressing and belt loading through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry solids, conditioning and active polymer, gravity-drainage contact, solids per belt width. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
